name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd

ledger.quote: We expect to see meaningful progress in our GTM plan also over the next 18 months to 20 months, and we expect that this will further strengthen our distribution as well as penetration.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.target: Meaningful progress in GTM over 18-20 months
ledger.verdict: The 18-20 month timeframe from November 2025 for go-to-market progress is still underway.

ledger.quote: Combined as we look at it from a B2C perspective, which is the way that we are approaching this, we see this scaling up to about Rs. 2,000 Cr. in the next 18 months - 24 months.
ledger.speaker: Kaleeswaran A.
ledger.target: Scale solar business to Rs. 2,000 Cr
ledger.verdict: The 18-24 month timeline from November 2025 to scale solar business to Rs 2,000 crore remains active.

ledger.quote: We do expect that the solar business, with it is strong profitability, strong retail connects, and strong return on capital, will likely become possibly the second largest business for Crompton within the next 1-2 years.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: The 1-2 year target timeline from November 2025 to make solar the second largest business is ongoing.

ledger.quote: And we expect this momentum to continue and indeed strengthen as we go forward with further product introductions in the BLDC segment.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: BLDC fans continued growth momentum with a 40% YoY expansion in general trade.
ledger.evidence: Our BLDC fans continued the strong momentum, especially in general trade, with the growth of 40% aided by focused portfolio interventions and improved reach.

ledger.quote: These products will become available to consumers in select markets in the next six to seven weeks.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.target: launch residential wires in select markets
ledger.verdict: Residential wires launched in South India in Q1 FY27 and expanded to three more markets.
ledger.evidence: We launched our wires business in South India in Q1FY27 and based on positive early traction, we have now extended it to Punjab, Delhi NCR and Gujarat in the previous quarter.

ledger.quote: And I am hoping that in the near term, we will be able to formally disclose to you orders that we have got in that segment.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: Management discussed B2C rooftop commencement across six states but did not formally disclose order numbers.

ledger.quote: There has been a price hike that has been taken in January, net price increase of about say one to one and a half percentage.
ledger.speaker: Kaleeswaran A
ledger.verdict: Management took price increases of 15-18% cumulatively over the past nine months to cover costs.
ledger.evidence: For fans, if you have to look at it, it is somewhere around 17–18% is what would have taken cumulatively in the last nine months.

ledger.quote: We are looking at two more rounds of price increase that would happen in Q4 and Q1.
ledger.speaker: Kaleeswaran A
ledger.verdict: Price increases of 15-18% were taken cumulatively across Q4 and Q1 periods.
ledger.evidence: For fans, if you have to look at it, it is somewhere around 17–18% is what would have taken cumulatively in the last nine months.

ledger.quote: The expectation, is that this order book will be executed over approximately the next 9 to 12 months.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: Execution of the solar rooftop order book is over 50% complete and on schedule.
ledger.evidence: We have executed more than 50% of our order book with the AP government.

ledger.quote: Our BLDC portfolio, which has been bolstered by product introductions earlier in the year is now growing at 30%-plus.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: BLDC fan portfolio continued growing above 30%, reaching 40% growth in general trade.
ledger.evidence: Our BLDC fans continued the strong momentum, especially in general trade, with the growth of 40% aided by focused portfolio interventions and improved reach.

ledger.quote: We will ramp up throughout the country. It will not be spread over the entire year, and we will not restrict our distribution to select towns or cities but seek to leverage the maximum extent of Crompton distribution that we have nationwide.
ledger.speaker: Shaleen Nayak
ledger.verdict: Wires rollout has expanded across South India, Punjab, Delhi NCR, and Gujarat, but not nationwide.
ledger.evidence: We launched our wires business in South India in Q1FY27 and based on positive early traction, we have now extended it to Punjab, Delhi NCR and Gujarat in the previous quarter.

ledger.quote: Over the next 3 - 4 months, you may expect to see a series of brand launch events showcasing the evolution and the future trajectory of the Crompton brand.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.target: brand launch events over next 3-4 months
ledger.verdict: Brand refresh identity and launch events were executed in August 2026 as planned.
ledger.evidence: in August 2026, we launched Crompton's refreshed brand identity featuring a new monogram, Cephyr, with a new tag and a distinctive sonic identity.

ledger.quote: And as I have told you in the past, that manufacturing plant will also include a large warehousing unit, and will spend about Rs. 350 crores.
ledger.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
ledger.verdict: Evaluation of the greenfield manufacturing plant remains in advanced stages without specified completion date.

open.quote: I do believe that exports can potentially be much larger. I think hopefully this will be this rate of growth will sustain over the next couple of years.
open.speaker: Promeet Ghosh
open.target: export growth to sustain over next couple of years

open.quote: When we reach a 12% EBITDA at that point of time, that is on a higher revenue base.
open.speaker: Kaleeswaran Arunachalam

read: Management consistently delivers on operational execution, brand initiatives, and passing through commodity price increases. However, specific metric disclosures for newer B2C solar order books remain vague.
questions: When will the company formally disclose B2C solar rooftop order book figures as previously committed?
What is the timeline for expanding the wires distribution nationwide beyond the four currently active regions?
bull: Revenue grew 18.1% YoY in Sep 2026 quarter to Rs 2,263 crore with 40% BLDC growth.
Executed over 50% of the Andhra Pradesh solar rooftop order book on schedule.
bear: OPM compressed from 11% in Mar 2025 to 9% in Sep 2026 due to input cost pressures.
Wires rollout remains limited to regional markets rather than achieving a full national footprint.
